name: Manipulator
description: All Hivers use manipulation on a constant basis but for most it is a means to an end. Those with more vision or who simply enjoy manipulation for its own sake may sometimes make a career out of it.

master_manipulator.name: Master Manipulator
master_manipulator.description: You focus on manipulation for its own sake, although there is always a goal to any project you undertake.

starfaring_manipulator.name: Starfaring Manipulator
starfaring_manipulator.description: You have travelled extensively and perhaps even learned how to operate a starship yourself. Of course, there will always be a reason why you do not get someone else to do the work for you.

military_leader.name: Military Leader
military_leader.description: You assumed a command position in the ground or space forces. Most of your subordinates were from other races of the Hive Federation and naturally they are the ones doing any actual fighting.

mishaps.1: You are seriously injured, equivalent to a roll of 2 on the Hiver Injury table.
mishaps.2: Repeated failures have disheartened you. Make a RES check. If you fail, you conclude that you are not fit to be a Manipulator. Lose a number of points from RES equal to the negative Effect. If you succeed, you realise someone is working against you. Gain an Enemy but you do not have to leave the career.
mishaps.3: A series of disasters befalls you and your reputation as a manipulator is in tatters. You must leave the career but are determined to prove you are in fact the best at what you do. Gain RES +1 but also D3 Rivals.
mishaps.4: You needed help and had to beg another Manipulator to assist you. This did not sit well but at least the rival demanded an extortionate price in money and deeds. You now have a Rival to whom you owe an enormous favour. If you do not repay your benefactor when the time comes you will gain a powerful Enemy.
mishaps.5: You were ejected from your home nest for taking your manipulations too far on a constant basis. The inferior nest-citizens were just too susceptible and that is not your fault.
mishaps.6: Your nest suffered a disaster and broke up, with most citizens finding new nests quickly. There are rumours you caused the problem — which may or may not be true. You are out on your own and have gained D3 Rivals who resent what you may or may not have done.

events.2: Disaster! Roll on the Mishap table.
events.3: You inveigle your way into taking part in a major project outside your normal field of endeavour. You may roll on any Service Skills table for any career and gain the indicated skill.
events.4: You work towards advancement and of course you succeed! Gain DM+4 on your next advancement check.
events.5: You are determined to achieve Manipulator status and become a legend among your people. Gain DM+1 to all future advancement checks. You may receive this bonus in future terms.
events.6: You decide you need to develop a particular skill. Make a RES check. If successful you may gain a level in any skill you possess.
events.8: You travel aboard starships. Take one level in Pilot, Astrogation or Engineer.
events.9: You become involved with the embassy and visit many other nests. Gain an Ally and a Contact.
events.10: You spend considerable time outside the Hive Federation, practising your manipulation skills on aliens with a very different culture. Gain a level of Streetwise and a non-Hiver Contact.
events.11: You act as a facilitator for a major endeavour — a diplomatic mission, a trade treaty or something similar. Gain RES +1 and an Ally.
events.12: Your home region suffers a disaster and naturally you are tasked with resolving it. Make a RES check. If successful you may make an immediate additional advancement check with DM+4. If this results in higher status than you already hold, you are advanced to this status. In addition, gain one level in any skill of your choice and a Contact outside Hiver society.
